nodes.text: $ZOE puts up a huge poster of sunflowers ringed by daisies on her wall to cover up the crack above her bed, while Sam cleans the dust off her desk.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, the poster almost covers it all up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whee.
Next, $ZOE makes her bed, fluffing the pillows and putting them on her bright sheets.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There we go!
Then $ZOE and Sam tackle cleaning the mold off the ceiling together.
And twenty minutes later, $ZOE jumps off the bed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not bad. It still looks like a shack, but it's a cheerful one.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's kind of sort of exactly what I wanted to hear!
$ZOE and Sam walk away from the improv booth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what'd you think of the clubs so far?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was fun! I can't wait to check out all the clubs when I actually enroll.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. I'm a little jealous. Centerscore U doesn't have this many options.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You'll just have to visit me a lot, and then I can share all of this with you!
They stroll past more booths and tents...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was... Enlightening. I don't know that I'm cut out for the extracurriculars at Kingston.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll find the right one for you at some point.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but right now, I could use a break.
They stroll past more booths and tents, looking for a place to rest...
$ZOE can see Lisa wince.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't really use my imagination there, did I?
But Lisa keeps going on!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: A `cane?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]cane?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Lisa laughs disdainfully.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: What is a cane going to do against a lasso?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Your lasso isn't a lasso! It's just a rope!
Lisa winces again, and $ZOE realizes she's just contradicted Lisa!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoops, broke that rule too!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Actually, we're both wrong! It's not a lasso `or` a rope! It's a whip!
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, we're both wrong! It's not a lasso [color=#3b78e2][i]or[/i][/color] a rope! It's a whip!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: And your cane is no match!
Lisa flicks her wrist out, and the rope snaps like a whip, falling across $ZOE's shoes!
This time, $ZOE knows enough to pretend to get captured! She falls dramatically to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nrh! Can't move!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Ha ha! Your gold is mine!
Lisa bends down to pick up a fake bag of gold as the audience claps around them. Lisa helps $ZOE up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How'd I do?

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: I wouldn't quit your day job...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, sorry...

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: No, don't be. It was still fun! Good luck with everything, okay?
$ZOE climbs on the cane like it's a pony and starts fake galloping around Lisa!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yah, Winchester! Good horse!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: A horse! Why didn't I think of that?
The crowd laughs.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: But a horse will not stop me! I shall lasso you with my superior lasso skills!
She swings the rope around her head again and tosses it onto $ZOE's cane! $ZOE fakes being thrown off a horse and stumbles to the side, cane in hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You got me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...But that was my plan all along! I just needed the horse because that's where I was hiding my bow and arrow!
$ZOE holds her cane up like a bow and strings a fake arrow up to it!
Lisa grins at her as the crowd laughs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Treacherous!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The crowd seems to really be enjoying this!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: But can your arrows save you from my venomous pet snake?!
Lisa throws the rope at $ZOE's feet, just as $ZOE looses her fake arrow from her fake bow!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: I've been shot! Fatally!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've been bit! Also fatally!
Both girls fall dramatically to the ground...
As the audience claps around them. Lisa and $ZOE get up and bow.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How'd I do?

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: You should think about doing more of these improv activities. You are a natural!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, I'm probably going to leave the acting up to the professionals, but thanks for choosing me!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Thanks for coming up! Good luck with everything, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... I have a cane?
Sam and $ZOE move on and find a group of people congregating around one tent.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's Lisa!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Lisa's a famous actress. She used to go to Twin Branches. I've never met her, but I've heard of her. I can't believe she's here!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Thanks for coming out, you guys! It's nice to know that I have fans at Kingston University!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: I've been asked here by Sketch Artist, a student group devoted to improv sketches!

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Improv is on-the-spot acting! It may seem daunting, but don't worry, anyone can be an improv master! And we're going to prove that today.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: I'm going to need a volunteer! You there! Come up! This is going to be great!
Lisa points at $ZOE and grins. $ZOE wades through the crowd and stands next to Lisa.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Have you done improv before?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Not much. Just go with the flow, don't contradict me, and don't forget to use your imagination!
Lisa turns to the crowd and starts speaking in a loud voice.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: So the way this game works is that $ZOE and I are going to grab a prop at random from this box...
She holds up a box.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: And we're going to act out a scene using our props as a focal point! Now, can someone from the audience give me a type of movie genre?
Lisa strains to hear the answers the crowd yells...

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: A western! Great! $ZOE and I are two people in the wild, wild West! Let's get started.
Lisa reaches in the box and pulls out a piece of rope! She holds it like a lasso, swinging the end of the rope in a circle above her.

nodes.speaker: Lisa
nodes.text: Give me all your gold, or I'm going to wrangle you like a cow!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no!
$ZOE reaches into the box and grabs... A cane!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's going to be awfully hard to catch me when I have...
He dumps in the sodium iodide! Almost instantaneously, the mixture foams up, spreading through the beaker and spilling over in a gigantic foam fountain!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, that's pretty cool...

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: And that is the magic of chemistry!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for sharing!

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Thanks for being a great assistant. You can always join the club...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll think about it.
He dumps in the acetic acid. It starts frothing and smoking...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is that smell?!

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Ack! What did you give me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The acetic acid?

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: No! That makes a poisonous gas! Don't breathe in!

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: `Don't breathe in!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't breathe in![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I knew I hated chemistry for a reason!
The guy frantically runs around the booth, grabbing other liquids and pouring them into the smoking solution... After a couple minutes, the air clears.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Yikes, that could've been bad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Just do me a favor and don't work in a lab?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, not after that...
$ZOE forgets what she's supposed to grab! She grabs a random beaker labeled 'acetic acid' and hands it to him!
Angie starts collecting her stuff.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I need to figure this amphitheater thing out. But I'll definitely see you around next year!
She jogs off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm glad I'm not doing anything related to politics. It isn't for me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's fun sometimes.
Sam and $ZOE walk to another booth where a guy is mixing chemicals into Erlenmeyer flasks and test tubes.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Hey ladies... Want to know more about the chemistry of love?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't know that's a thing you can put in a bottle.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think I speak for both of us when I say that we're not interested.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Hey wait, what about the magic of chemistry? Free demo!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What kind of demo?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You shouldn't trust me around fire.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Nothing like that. We're going to do a simple experiment. I'm going to mix up a very special solution.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: When I point to you, you're going to hand me the sodium iodide in that beaker over there. And then you'll see something that will knock your socks off!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I like where my socks are.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll help!

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Excellent.
He mixes some ingredients together and puts them in a large beaker.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: All right, hand it to me!
$ZOE grabs the...

nodes.speaker: Terran
nodes.text: Don't you think we would've already thought of that?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: To be honest, we've been so busy butting heads about who's right that we haven't.

nodes.speaker: Terran
nodes.text: Building an amphitheater in the middle of a plant preserve is an awful idea! People would trample the plants!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Unless we build a suspended footbridge for the traffic.

nodes.speaker: Terran
nodes.text: What about trash and litter?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: A stringent no-outside-foods policy and biodegradable paper products all across the board.

nodes.speaker: Terran
nodes.text: How would we pay for all that?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: With the ticket sales from live performers!

nodes.speaker: Terran
nodes.text: That's a great idea! I'll write up the proposal tonight! I don't know why I'm still yelling!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Because you care passionately about the environment?

nodes.speaker: Terran
nodes.text: Yup!
They shake hands, and Terran walks away.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Looks like you have a promising career in student gov, $ZOE.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if one suggestion makes a senator.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Still, you should check it out next year. We could use more decisive women on our council.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll definitely think about it.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think you should build the amphitheater. The Student Council serves the students after all, and culture is important for them.

nodes.speaker: Terran
nodes.text: Of course you'd side with your friend!

nodes.speaker: Terran
nodes.text: It's short-sighted people like you that will drive our planet to the brink of disaster!
Terran pulls out a spray bottle from his backpack.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is that?

nodes.speaker: Terran
nodes.text: If you're going to spit on the planet, the planet is going to spit on you!
He points the spray bottle at the girls! Sam ducks! $ZOE and Angie get sprayed with a sticky sap that coats their clothes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eww!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Gross!
By the time the girls think to retaliate, Terran's run off. Sam crawls to her feet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You guys okay?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'd like to say this is the first time that's happened, but... It's not. Terran gets like that when he's confronted with a solution he doesn't like.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I shouldn't have said anything then.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's okay. You tried.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Knowing the two of you... You'll figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, there's some comfort in that.
There's a knock at the door, and $ZOE hears Missy's perky voice on the other side.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Rise and shine! Who's ready to go to an activity fair?
$ZOE opens the door, and Missy bursts in.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Well, there you are, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I'm so sorry that you had to get an absolutely hideous place...
Missy looks around the room.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Wow, look at what you did to this room! It went from ohmygosh to posh!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I was going to say that you can reapply when the school year actually starts...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: But I can see now that you can make any place a home. Very nice.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: You can come back and decorate your room more later.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Wow, this room is even more awful than I remember!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Well, you can reapply for different housing when the school year actually starts...
She glances at the disheveled bed and the crack in the wall and frowns.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Maybe I can try to put in a word for you sooner. This is just `depressing!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I can try to put in a word for you sooner. This is just [color=#3b78e2][i]depressing![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: But we'll sort all that out later!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: For now, it's time for the Activity Fair!
Missy leads $ZOE and her tour group back to an expansive grassy area where several tents for clubs, sports, and other interest groups stand!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Welcome to the Activity Fair! If you ever wanted to talk to a lot of crazy new people and sign up for clubs, this is the place!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, there are probably a hundred booths and tents out here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is so cool!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Here at Kingston, we take our extracurriculars super seriously! All students are expected to participate and become involved in the organizations around campus.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: A well-rounded Kingston student is a happy Kingston student, after all!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: So go ahead and get more information on the clubs you find absolutely intriguing! I won't be far away if you need me!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: And don't forget that dinner activities are starting in an hour!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Good luck!
$ZOE, Sam, and the rest of the students start down a long row of tents.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is so amazing! It's like there's an organization for everything!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where do you even start?

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: You can start right here! Tae kwan do, tennis, bowling... Down this way!

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Or you can join The All Or None Alliance of Sports Lovers Everywhere! We do it all! Or none of it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, uh, no thank you...

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: What about you? You look exactly like a swimmer!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Exactly what it's supposed to!
The girl squints and puts her hands out like she's measuring Sam.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Great shoulders, nice build... We could use someone exactly like you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ookay... We're heading out now.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Yes! Channel that anger! It makes you go faster in the pool!
Sam steers $ZOE away down another row where they pass several special interest clubs...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think we're in the food section. I just saw a club devoted to bread and cheese.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They have samples!
Sam reaches down for a taste and has her hand snatched by the person running the booth.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: I wouldn't do that if I were you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why not? You got a problem?

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: Well, the Roquefort you're about to put in your mouth isn't going to taste very good on that particular multi-grain cracker.
Sam grabs the sample anyway and pops the cheese-cracker combination in her mouth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know what you're talking about. This is amazing.
The Kingston student tries one himself... And grins.

nodes.speaker: Student
nodes.text: This `is` good! I never would've thought the garlic would meld with the flavors of the cheese so well! You know your cheese! Hey, you want to be in our club?
nodes.text_bbcode: This [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] good! I never would've thought the garlic would meld with the flavors of the cheese so well! You know your cheese! Hey, you want to be in our club?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No way.
$ZOE and Sam walk away from the table.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For not actually being a student here, you seem to be getting invitations to all the best clubs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Ha.` Because I was really foaming at the mouth to be in the `cheese` club.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ha.[/i][/color] Because I was really foaming at the mouth to be in the [color=#3b78e2][i]cheese[/i][/color] club.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What about you? Haven't you seen something that you like?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe we can try something in student government. Over here!
$ZOE and Sam walk past a booth under the banner 'Leaders for the Advancement of a Civilized Society' where two people are having a spirited debate. $ZOE recognizes one of them as Angie!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Angie!
Angie breaks from her debate to look at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $ZOE? Sam? Wow, I haven't seen you two since I graduated from Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I didn't know you were going here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yep! I'm a new freshman here. It'd be great to catch up with you...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You too!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But I just need to finish one thing up. Kingston University is tearing down an old building in the middle of campus, and Student Council is going to vote on what's going to go there.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I want to turn the space into an amphitheater to promote the cultural arts here at Kingston. We're a little far away from the main cultural hubs and cities, so this would be a great opportunity to attract singers and performers.
She turns to the person in the booth with her.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But Terran here wants to turn it into a nature conservatory for endangered plant species.

nodes.speaker: Terran
nodes.text: False foxgloves, puttyroot, and tickleweeds need our help! These plants are key markers, and losing them can undermine the ecological processes of an entire biome!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have no idea what he said.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: He's saying the more plants that go extinct, the more it can damage our environment. Which is true. But it's not like this is the best habitat for those species to live in.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: My amphitheater is better for all the students on campus.

nodes.speaker: Terran
nodes.text: My plan is better for all the people on earth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You should...

options.label: Build what's best for the students.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Seriously? You haven't seen him in how knows long, and all you want to tell him is 'hello'?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's just how it would start out, you know?
Sam makes a gagging noise in her throat.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, what am I supposed to say? I can't just go up to him and tell him that I love him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was kind of hoping it'd just happen.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's all you're going to say to him? Isn't he more than a friend to you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course he is.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But even if I'm sure about how I feel, I don't know how he feels about me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to force our entire history on him if he's... If he's moved on.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We said we'd be friends when we parted. I'm happy starting from there.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And we'll see what happens.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Right off the bat? You really want to do that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you think I'm coming off too strong?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think I'd `open` with that.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think I'd [color=#3b78e2][i]open[/i][/color] with that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, now I have no idea what I want to say!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe it's a good thing your phone broke.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? Maybe it's good because you'll have time to think about it!
$ZOE starts with the bed, trying to put the sheets on and getting tangled in them!
Suddenly, the thought of cleaning the entire room seems hopeless!
She plops down on the unmade bed and buries her head in her hands.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is never going to work... I can't really see how we're going to get everything cleaned up in here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not `that` bad...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] bad...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It'll get done. Just... Try not to think about it too much.
$ZOE nods her head and half-heartedly makes the bed while Sam makes conversation.
Kimi grumbles as she grabs her stuff.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Come on, Em.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Actually, Emily, can you stay? We wanted to discuss a project with you. You know, a `Team One` project.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, Emily, can you stay? We wanted to discuss a project with you. You know, a [color=#3b78e2][i]Team One[/i][/color] project.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh, sure...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What? Is it your plan for stealing the extra credit cone again? You know, you guys were totally out of line yesterday when you took that cone from us! That cone belonged to Team Two!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Here's a tip. Strength matters. Aggression matters. If you don't have either, then your sad little team is not winning that cone anytime soon.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And you should probably go now. Bye!
Maria nods at the door, which Mr. Bernstein has just entered through. Kimi sits sulkily next to Dex up front.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Kimi. Where have you been? We've been here for fifteen minutes--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You came before the bell even rang?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We love getting here early! You can watch the light breaking in through the window! It feels like the sun activates my learning!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, okay...

nodes.speaker: Dex

nodes.text: Uh... You help the sorority house do... Charity?
She leaves her twin and $ZOE to talk.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, Aria, you work with Quinn to help the sorority house do...
Ava's smile fades quickly.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Oh... Really? I guess it `was` a new recipe...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... Really? I guess it [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] a new recipe...

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: Well, what's wrong with them? You should at least tell her `why!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, what's wrong with them? You should at least tell her [color=#3b78e2][i]why![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It's okay, Aria. When they came out, I thought they were kind of doughy myself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But your frosting is to die for!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Thanks... Anyway, I should probably put different cupcakes out. Excuse me!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Doughy?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But only a little bit! I really love the frosting you made with it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And it's so sweet that you thought of the people who couldn't eat dairy!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Ha ha, thanks. You know you're the `second` girl to tell me that today! There's this other freshman girl who's so super nice! She said the same thing to me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha, thanks. You know you're the [color=#3b78e2][i]second[/i][/color] girl to tell me that today! There's this other freshman girl who's so super nice! She said the same thing to me!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: And it's hard to feel criticized when you put it like that...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I actually thought they came out a little doughy myself. Any tips for fixing it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you just mix the batter a little less, it might do the trick.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Yeah... I think you might be right. Anyway, I'm going to put more cupcakes out. Excuse me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... They're uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not that good?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Is that so?
Mr. Bernstein looms over them.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: I assume since you are spending more time squabbling than working, that you are all done!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Who would like to go first?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We will, Mr. Bernstein. Team Two would like to call itself the `Wirewolves!` We value academics and ambition, so naturally, our crest features the wolf because it is cunning, intelligent, and loyal.
nodes.text_bbcode: We will, Mr. Bernstein. Team Two would like to call itself the [color=#e23b3b][i]Wirewolves![/i][/color] We value academics and ambition, so naturally, our crest features the wolf because it is cunning, intelligent, and loyal.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Our colors are blue and red to represent our commitment to loyalty and our ability to be aggressive, respectively.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Excellent. And Team One?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Our animal is the lion because it is brave and strong. Our colors are, uh...
Maria looks down at their half-finished banner, which is gold and white with only a small bit of red at the bottom.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: White, gold, and red.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Because we are strong and ambitious, and we take what we want when the mood strikes us! We are Team One, now known as `Kitty Pride!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because we are strong and ambitious, and we take what we want when the mood strikes us! We are Team One, now known as [color=#3b78e2][i]Kitty Pride![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The nerds snicker, and Maria glares at them.
Mr. Bernstein nods his head and strokes his mustache thoughtfully.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: All right. I've heard both teams, and I found one side to have more thoughtful reasoning than the other. I must award the cone to the `Wirewolves!`
nodes.text_bbcode: All right. I've heard both teams, and I found one side to have more thoughtful reasoning than the other. I must award the cone to the [color=#e23b3b][i]Wirewolves![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What? If this is because our banner wasn't colored red, it was Kimi's fault!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: If Kimi hadn't been distracting our teammate, then we would've finished.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's not fair! `Your` teammate came over to our side to talk!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not fair! [color=#e23b3b][i]Your[/i][/color] teammate came over to our side to talk!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Enough! The Wirewolves made an excellent case for their animal and colors. Wirewolves, you may take a cone!
Dex takes a cone from Mr. Bernstein as the nerds cheer!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: I shall see you all tomorrow then.
Maria comes up to Dex and Kimi after Mr. Bernstein leaves.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: This isn't over, Dex. We're `still` going to win this game. Come on, Kitty Pride. We need to come up with a plan!
nodes.text_bbcode: This isn't over, Dex. We're [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] going to win this game. Come on, Kitty Pride. We need to come up with a plan!

nodes.text: The cheerleaders follow Maria, and Maria looks at Emily.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Do you mind meeting with us for just one second to talk about our `plan?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you mind meeting with us for just one second to talk about our [color=#3b78e2][i]plan?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily sighs, looks from Kimi to Maria... And follows Maria out the door.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Worst. Class. Ever.
Back at Kingston...
$ZOE is ushered inside the L.O.L. sorority house with a couple other girls from Missy's group.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Missy, it's so nice to see you!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: It's nice to see `you!` I have another group of girls for you to meet!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's nice to see [color=#3b78e2][i]you![/i][/color] I have another group of girls for you to meet!

nodes.text: Missy turns to $ZOE and the other girls.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Girls, this is the President of L.O.L., and she'll be taking care of you this evening!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Hello! Hi! I'm Quinn, a sophomore here at Kingston. I'm so excited to see all your faces!
She gestures to the three girls standing next to her.

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: And these girls over here are my `beauty`-filled right-hand ladies!
nodes.text_bbcode: And these girls over here are my [color=#3b78e2][i]beauty[/i][/color]-filled right-hand ladies!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Ava and Aria over here help me with coordinating social events! They're twins!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Just don't get these two mixed up. They hate it!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I do L.O.L.'s `charity events.` If you rush for our house, you'll be really involved in the community! We build houses and improve lives!
nodes.text_bbcode: I do L.O.L.'s [color=#3b78e2][i]charity events.[/i][/color] If you rush for our house, you'll be really involved in the community! We build houses and improve lives!

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: And I'm in charge of everything `fun!` Spring Break trip to Cancun? Water fights on the Quad? I'm on it!
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm in charge of everything [color=#3b78e2][i]fun![/i][/color] Spring Break trip to Cancun? Water fights on the Quad? I'm on it!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Ha ha, thanks, Aria. As you can tell, a sorority can be a very rewarding and fun experience!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Unlike other sororities on campus, we're a real family here! So we hope you'll consider rushing with us in the fall!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Right now, I'd `love` to show all of you the house...
nodes.text_bbcode: Right now, I'd [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] to show all of you the house...

nodes.text: Quinn leads the new freshmen girls around the house. And the more $ZOE learns, the more she actually wants to join!
Upstairs in one of the bedrooms...

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: Up here, we have rooms for the sisters. You have to share a room with someone else, but there's plenty of space!
$ZOE notes how comfortable the furnishings look.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So much better than the dorm accommodations!
Downstairs and outside...

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: We have a pool out here and some chairs for lounging. Our house faces the woods and the lake in the back where you can picnic or do water sports!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ooh! This is so pretty!
And downstairs and inside...

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: And last but not least, we have a fully stocked kitchen and an in-house chef who makes our meals for us. We believe in being good to our bodies here at L.O.L., so the meals are gourmet and super healthy!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: The house special is a wonderful chicken pasta primavera with fresh garden vegetables!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds delicious!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: But we also realize it's fun to indulge...
And Quinn opens a door into the dining room proper where snacks and drinks are laid out!
$ZOE gasps. A tower of perfectly frosted cupcakes sits in the middle of a table of treats!

nodes.speaker: Quinn
nodes.text: This is the end of the tour guided by me! Now please enjoy drinks and snacks in the kitchen! And feel free to ask us anything you want about our house!
$ZOE squares her shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is it. If I want to talk to Howard at the party and get a shot at living in this house, I'd better do my best.
$ZOE sidles over to the cupcake table and admires the tower.
Ava and Aria join $ZOE at the table.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: These cupcakes are so beautiful!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Yeah? You bake too?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `love` baking!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] baking!

nodes.speaker: Aria
nodes.text: Then you're in good company. In addition to helping out charities, my sister `loves` to bake.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then you're in good company. In addition to helping out charities, my sister [color=#3b78e2][i]loves[/i][/color] to bake.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I really do. Baking is like magic to me. You just mix a few ingredients together, and poof! You've made something that will cheer people up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I love how it makes the kitchen smell...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Yes, exactly! What's your name again?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Nice. Hey, since you're into baking, can you give me your honest opinion on these new vegan cupcakes I've made? I want to make sure anyone from any dietary plan can enjoy them!
$ZOE takes a bite... And notices the cupcakes taste too thick in the middle!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The texture is...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No, we can't 'all get along'. We don't negotiate with people who just steal and take from the righteous!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, we were enemies the minute you jokers insulted my team!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So what now? Are you going to fight? Because I'm pretty sure I know which side is going to win!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We shall fight on the field of the Extra Credit Cone!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We're arguing over `markers!` And none of that's going to help either of us get the cone, which is the real reason we're arguing in the first place!
nodes.text_bbcode: We're arguing over [color=#3b78e2][i]markers![/i][/color] And none of that's going to help either of us get the cone, which is the real reason we're arguing in the first place!

nodes.text: Maria and Dex glare at one another... Then part.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: This petty squabbling will get us nowhere.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yay. I'm right.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We'll settle who is the better team on the field of the Extra Credit Cone!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes. I guess I'm just feeling off.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Well, to cheer you up, I wanted to invite you to meet my fellow sisters at Lambda Omega Lambda!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: It seems like you've been kind of struggling to fit in at Kingston...
$ZOE meets up with Sam again at the Activity Fair.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Did you see him?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No. I didn't get the chance. But I do know he's going to be at a party tomorrow at the L.O.L. sorority house. You didn't happen to see their table around here, did you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have no idea where the sorority tables are...
$ZOE looks around. She spots Missy running over to her.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: There you are, $ZOE! I was looking for you everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: It's time to go. You ready?
$ZOE looks back towards M.A.N. fraternity sadly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure...
But in one flying tackle, Rishi takes her down! They roll across the grass, and $ZOE lands unceremoniously in front of the gate...
Where Missy Perkins is standing!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: $ZOE?! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I, uh...

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: She was trying to sneak into our party!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: $ZOE, I expected better from you. I just don't know what to say.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I'm totally mortified!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Missy, I didn't mean any harm...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: For not meaning to do anything, you've certainly managed to get yourself in a lot of trouble!

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Hey, Sean, I called security! They'll be right over!
As Rishi clamps a hand on her shoulder, $ZOE looks back at Howard...
He says something which makes everyone laugh, and the girl next to him throws her arms around him, pulling him into a tight hug!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And after all that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard didn't even see me!
As campus security escorts her away from the activity fair, $ZOE knows in her heart...
She has failed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa, what's that? I think that sorority over there is having an impromptu bikini party!
$ZOE points past them, and when they look, she ducks under them and runs through the gates.

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: What? Where?

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: It was a trick, you idiot! She's getting away!
$ZOE runs as fast as she can, trying to maneuver through the crowd...
But Rishi and Sean catch up to her quickly! $ZOE plunges into the crowd trying to evade them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It just so happens that I just joined the L.O.L. sorority.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm one of their newest members!

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: That's funny because they haven't done any rush events.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, but I had an in! I know someone there!

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: You do? I've hung out with all the girls at L.O.L., so which one do you know?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... I know Kara... Belle? Karabelle!

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Oh yeah, Karabelle! She's a laugh and a half!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, isn't she just?

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: She's also someone I just made up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, she's not!

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: It's all right. I don't hold it against you. This Howard guy must be pretty important.

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: I like that you tried.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's not going to get me in, is it?

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: Look, I'd love to invite you in, but seriously, we have strict rules about who can come into the house right now.

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: We'd get in so much trouble if the other guys found out we let you in.

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: If you really want to see him, there'll be a huge party tomorrow. It'll be epic. You should come.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great! Where is it?

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: Well, here's the thing. It's L.O.L.'s Admit Weekend party. You have to be invited.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aren't you inviting me now?

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: `They` have to invite you.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]They[/i][/color] have to invite you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh. Where are they?

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: They're probably at the Activity Fair right now, trying to recruit new freshmen. You just need to talk to them and impress them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I will. I'll see you tomorrow.
$ZOE hesitates, unsure what to do!
And suddenly, inspiration strikes!
When suddenly, $ZOE looks across the way and sees Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard!
He's wearing a crown and is surrounded by a crowd of people. $ZOE rushes forward, intending to weave through the group to him...
And two cute college guys step in front of her.

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: Whoa, freshman! You're not allowed on M.A.N. territory!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Man` territory?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Man[/i][/color] territory?

nodes.speaker: Rishi
nodes.text: Yeah, you know... The fraternity M.A.N.? This is our turf.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, but I just want to talk to that guy over there...
She points at Howard.

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: Yeah, you and every other girl here. Join the line.
$ZOE looks and realizes the crowd around Howard is mostly girls. One of them has her arm around him. She's wearing a crown that matches his, and she's giggling at something he's saying.
She turns her attention back to the two guys.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't make just one tiny, tiny exception? For me?

nodes.speaker: Sean
nodes.text: We're pretty exclusive. Only M.A.N. brothers and L.O.L. sorority sisters allowed this weekend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, now what am I supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what now? You really ready to do this college thing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know. Yes? No? I was excited to get here, but now that I am, it's all so new. Do you think I'll fit in?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Pfft. You'll be fine. You'll make new friends, and I'm sure Howard'll help you out...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh yeah!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I should try calling him.
$ZOE plugs her phone into the wall outlet... As soon as she does, sparks fly out, and electricity surges through her phone!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no!
$ZOE frantically presses buttons on her phone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't turn it on! It's totally busted!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Aw, geez, that sucks...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you think we have time to find a store and get a new phone?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No. Missy said she'd be back in thirty minutes. Time's almost up. You can borrow my phone though.
Sam hands her phone over, and $ZOE punches in a number from memory.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh shoot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard changed his number right before he went to Kingston. I don't know his new one at all. You don't happen to have it in your contacts, do you?
She looks through Sam's contacts.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Actually, he's not in my phone. I deleted him the first time you guys broke up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw, Sam... That's so sweet!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And entirely unhelpful.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I hope he doesn't think I'm ignoring him. Or worse, that I'm not interested!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've been talking nonstop since the Talent Show. I think he'll forgive you if you don't call him during Admit Weekend. You've been so busy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're right.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The first chance we get, we'll find a store and get you a new phone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides, do you even know what you're going to say when you do talk to him?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... I haven't thought about it. I mean, I just thought I'd tell him...

nodes.prompt: I just thought I'd tell him...

options.label: That I'm glad I have a friend here.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I just thought I'd tell him...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: They're hosting a mixer for some of the new girls on campus.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're talking about L.O.L.?

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I heard something about a party they're throwing tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Well, aren't you in-the-know? Yes, they have a big Admit Weekend party for freshmen girls they're interested in recruiting to their sorority.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Hey, if you make a good impression, you could be invited. I went to their party when I was a freshman. It was so `so` fun!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, if you make a good impression, you could be invited. I went to their party when I was a freshman. It was so [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are we really going to be spending an entire evening with sorority girls? They're like the cheerleaders of college life. Perky, blonde, and bossy!
Missy laughs.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: I know people totally think sorority girls are hard to relate to, but the girls at L.O.L. are great. $ZOE, I really think you'll like them.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: You would too, Sam...

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: But unfortunately, only Kingston students can attend. Family members have their own mixer in the recreational facility if you want to attend that.

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: And, of course, there are special treats in the campus restaurants tonight for guests!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I like treats!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: $ZOE, are you ready to go?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just a second.
$ZOE turns to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You'll be okay by yourself?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh yeah. I can amuse myself for an hour or two.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are `you` going to be okay by yourself?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] going to be okay by yourself?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm really nervous. What if they don't like me? Or what if I mess up? Or what if they find out my deep dark secrets from my past and judge me for them?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do you have any deep dark secrets?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: None that will come back to haunt me, hopefully.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then you'll be fine. You're sweet and nice, and as long as nothing goes terribly wrong, I'm sure you'll charm the designer jeans off those girls.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, I will. Getting invited to L.O.L's party might be my only chance this weekend at seeing Howard... So I'll have to!

nodes.speaker: Missy
nodes.text: Come on, $ZOE. We have people to see!
And in a Twin Branches classroom far, far away...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: This concludes the lesson on literacy in the Middle Ages. I want a four-page essay from you detailing the rise of monastic learning as educational development.
A groan goes up in the classroom.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: Don't force me to make it six pages!
The groaning stops. Mr. Bernstein looks around satisfied.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: We're ending class a little early today for the extra credit portion of the day.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: If you haven't figured it out by now, the teams I created for the extra credit work are to simulate the real tension between countries and houses during this period in European history.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: This afternoon, we're going to liven things up a bit and give your teams more personality. You will be giving your team an official name as well as creating a medieval coat of arms to represent yourselves!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah! This is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: For your coat of arms, you'll put the name of your team, your animal, and your house colors on these banners I've printed for you.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I `love` colors!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] colors!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: I expect you not only to finish your coat of arms by the end of class but to explain why the elements on it best represent your team.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Bernstein
nodes.text: The side with the best banner and explanation will receive the cone.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Hear that, Maria? This is a challenge of actual creativity and intelligence. Not some brute force tactic.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're just angry because my strategy `worked.`

The All or None Alliance `always` gives out special swag to new recruits! You could get a jersey or a new sports bag!
The Bread and Cheese Club gives out complimentary bread boxes!
And I can get these things if I listen to you talk?
All right. I don't have anywhere to go for an hour. Spill it.

Sam has used her considerable influence to get exactly what she wants!

I do really like this cheese wedge pillow you gave me. And this new bread knife can cut through any carb!

Hmmm, I guess Puddles could use another stick... I'll take it!

See you when you come back for the first day of school!
Er, well... See about that... Did I forget to mention that... I'm not actually a student here?
Didn't ask! Thanks for all the stuff! It's great! Go Centerscore U!
